scope_hashes.method: SHA256 of sorted production-relative path + TAB + raw-file SHA256 + LF; UTF-8. File counts name the exact sets below. Fingerprinting is not a claim of rereading every inventoried file.

scope81.members: scope67 plus the 14 explicitly listed calendar owners

method.scope: One complete declared affected-material round. Read all three current T037 H2s, the full current healer setting024, all three corresponding script and final H2s, and the preceding clash closure in both descendants. Compare the actual cached before and current treatment, then trace the changed pronoun through identity, observation limits, treatment, carrying guards, death and report closure. HTML comments were masked before reading.
method.isolation: No author, review, notes or draft body was opened. No verdict from those records is used. Only current bodies, actual parents, setting024 and unchanged contract questions supply this round's judgments.

common: unlocated inventories/unmarked gaze changes/vague impressions replacing required values
speech: neighboring action repeated in another register
scripts: interpretive label instead of performable operation
missing view/impossible position or sightline/unsupported core appearance
screenplay: weight lost to uniform short beat

method.applicability: The setting and treatment receive identity/fidelity and document-expression checks. Script/final sentences receive their applicable common, speech and layer-expression questions; downstream paragraphs also receive actual-parent differentiation and value checks. Population questions are applied only to the changed dependency, not claimed as a fresh whole-work test.
method.sentence_results: Every listed sentence unit was read; - records no clear applicable named failure. Unlisted units receive no fresh negative.
method.locators: hN selects current H2 order; pN counts annotation-masked Markdown blocks including headings/navigation; sN is a punctuation locator. Character spans address annotation-masked UTF-8-sig decoded source.
method.quote_policy: All before/after and evidence quotes are literal substrings in the named H2 and block. NFC plus Unicode-whitespace collapse is the only allowed normalized fallback; none is used.
method.preservation: Do not reopen unchanged no/ambiguous passages by preference. Required treatment/carrying/report actions, simple instructions, short speech, meaningful waiting, documentary time labels and ordinary male pronouns remain protected.
limits: The 67/81/82 sets are fingerprint inventories, not fresh complete-text approvals. Actual reading coverage is listed separately.
Only setting024 is freshly read as a settings owner. Unchanged medical, guards, architecture and coup settings are not newly audited against external evidence.
No clinical diagnosis, external historical verification, media, measured timing or recorded performance is tested.
The healer's observational record in the treatment is realized downstream through treatment and death reports; this check does not require a redundant new spoken report.
No full initial sentence table or whole-work completion review is regenerated.

decision.reason: The revised he refers to Seokyeon, matching setting024's male healer and his restriction to reporting only what he observed. It changes neither who treats Heonchung nor what the healer knows or can authorize. The descendants retain temporary reduction of bleeding, worsening from the wound and blood loss, death after three days, four living carrying guards and distinct injury/death/royal-order disclosure. Namsaeng's initial ignorance and later abandonment of renegotiation remain. No applicable named expression or parent-fidelity failure is established by this one-word correction.

evidence.quote: His name and birth year of 624 are invented.
After death he reports only the course he observed.
Three days later the answers stop.
All four guards are alive outside.
